answer: No cask passes the customs house until the officer has dipped it, weighed it and matched it against the manifest, because duty unpaid is duty stolen from the crown. Engine driver logbook with railway company attestation is the dipping that proves the cask: eight-year logbook, 90,000 miles driven, boiler inspections, annual medical. Smuggle a false mirror past the quay and the cask is seized, the importer pays the duty doubled, and the copper is forfeited to the revenue, while the delta is entered in the customs book and read at the next audit.
